title: Affine-local invertibility of the canonical dualizing coefficient mate
statement: In the setting of [def-coef-finite-dualizing-data], assume ell differs from the characteristic p. For each n≤m and each affine open V of X, the exact derived inverse image to V of the specified ordinary etale coefficient mate u_mn is invertible. This asserts only affine restrictions; global descent and quotient equations are not conclusions.

proof.text: Use the split global invertibility theorem for the finite etale dualizing comparison, then the standard functorial preservation of isomorphisms under the affine inverse-image derived functor.

proof_origin.place: global mate invertibility followed by functorial transport
